name: ebenezer
description: Ebenezer: Telegram bot + scheduler on Supabase Edge Functions

scripts.bot:dev: supabase status -o env --override-name api.url=SUPABASE_URL --override-name auth.service_role_key=SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY > supabase/.temp/local.env && deno run --allow-net --allow-env --config supabase/functions/deno.json --env-file=supabase/.temp/local.env --env-file=supabase/functions/.env scripts/dev-bot.ts
scripts.dev:due: supabase status -o env --override-name api.url=SUPABASE_URL --override-name auth.service_role_key=SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY > supabase/.temp/local.env && deno run --allow-net --allow-env --config supabase/functions/deno.json --env-file=supabase/.temp/local.env scripts/dev-due.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:db
scripts.check: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/*/index.ts scripts/*.ts && deno lint --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions scripts && deno fmt --check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions scripts && npm run typecheck --workspace miniapp
scripts.deploy: supabase functions deploy telegram-bot scheduler-tick api
scripts.cloud:dev:deploy: set -a && . ./.env.dev && set +a && supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" -p "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" && supabase db push -p "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" --yes && supabase functions deploy telegram-bot scheduler-tick api --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --use-api
scripts.cloud:dev:secrets: set -a && . ./.env.dev && set +a && supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/functions/.env --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"
scripts.cloud:dev:webhook: set -a && . ./.env.dev && . supabase/functions/.env && set +a && PROJECT_REF="$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" deno run --allow-net --allow-env --config supabase/functions/deno.json scripts/set-webhook.ts
